title: Broad exception caught at 1 sites (L64)
detail: `except Exception` without re-raise swallows unexpected errors silently. Suggested fix: catch only known exception types from the callee.

title: Inconsistent return statements: 1 functions mix explicit/implicit returns
detail: Functions return a value on some paths and fall off the end (returning `None`) on others. Callers expecting a return value may receive `None` unexpectedly. Suggested fix: add explicit `return` on all branches.
